items.question: After how many minutes of waiting can a Captain cancel the ride?
items.gold: Captains have the right to cancel the ride after 5-10 minutes of waiting time.
items.fact: Captains may cancel rides after 5-10 minutes waiting.

items.question: Can a Captain pick up more passengers than the car's capacity?
items.gold: No, Captains can't pick up passengers more than the car capacity.
items.fact: Captains cannot exceed car capacity for passenger safety.
